title: Fresh install
summary: A device that never saw Sidevoice, and a machine whose core runs but has paired nothing: the first screen a person sees, and pairing from it.
steps: The page opens on a device paired with nothing: it says so and offers to pair.
Ask the machine for a code (Pairing code, below): the real connector asks the real core for one.
Paste it where the page asks for a code, and name this device.
The machine shows as paired and reachable; with no agent connected, the room has no conversation yet.
